title: I have found my people
content: Hello, Like others I stumbled across this after being introduced to reddit by my fiance. I go to the same dreamscape every night. It's huge and only in the last couple years did I realise every dream I have is there, in diffirent areas. There is a shopping centre ( im uk) but in the middle of it is a main area that connects to a lot of diffirent things. A museum, a boat dock, an airport ( Flights are real time so I always wake up before I land) There is a train station but I seem to only be able to go there when I am actually getting on a train. There are busses and bus stops but only a couple a night and so hundreds of people queue outside. I can get the bus to a house and another shopping centre so far but for some reasons the busses scare me. Theres a type of college built into the "mall" and there are classes with symbols I dont understand. I always have the feeling I am late or missing a class. Theres a huge concert hall, locker rooms with showers and beds with no windows, a pool. There is a museum with a wooden staircase that leads into the air endlessly. The only thing I have that I havent seen mentioned is that I have jobs depending on the dream. Sometimes im a concert runner, other times I work at the pool. Ive never seen myself in a mirror or been able to do anything lucid other than get on transport which I always try to do. Sound familiar?
